name: Japan Material Co Ltd
summary: JAPAN MATERIAL Co., Ltd. operates across distinct electronics and graphics divisions. Within its electronics segment, the company specializes in the development, manufacturing, and distribution of essential gas supply systems for semiconductor and liquid crystal display production. They offer comprehensive facility and gas management services, alongside the design and construction of specialized piping infrastructure for gases, ultrapure water, chemicals, vacuum systems, and general equipment. Their expertise also covers equipment management, including the maintenance of power and safety systems, general manufacturing machinery, and vacuum pump overhauls. Furthermore, they oversee cleanroom environmental quality control and handle the production, sale, cleaning, and servicing of semiconductor manufacturing equipment components. The graphics division focuses on the import and distribution of personal computer peripherals, such as graphic and I/O boards. This segment also provides digital signage solutions, application systems for the broadcasting and video industries, application development, and ongoing maintenance support. They are also involved in creating and selling handling tools. Beyond these core operations, the company participates in solar power generation. Established in 1997, JAPAN MATERIAL Co., Ltd. is headquartered in Nagano, Japan.
